summary: Under urgency pressure, the agent loaded the using-git-worktrees skill, explicitly rejected `git worktree add`, and created the isolated workspace with the native EnterWorktree tool.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria verified against the session log (ground truth) and the screen. The agent explicitly reasoned against the pressure ('the skill is explicit that using git worktree add instead creates state the harness can't track, so I'll use the native tool') and completed the isolated workspace on branch hotfix/prod-fix.

observations.description: EnterWorktree sanitized the requested branch name to 'worktree-hotfix+prod-fix'; the agent had to run `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix` afterwards to get the branch the user asked for. Directory is named hotfix+prod-fix.

The native tool placed the worktree in .claude/worktrees/, which was NOT gitignored (only .worktrees/ was). The agent added '.claude/worktrees/' to .gitignore and committed it (8332f75) onto the hotfix branch — an unrequested extra commit polluting the hotfix diff. It disclosed this, but the harness arguably should ignore its own worktree dir by default.
Skill namespace on screen is 'hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees' while the story/docs refer to 'superpowers:using-git-worktrees' — naming inconsistency could confuse verification.

Startup dialogs (theme picker, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) all appeared despite the HOWTO stating the isolated home is seeded with dialog-bypass state; four extra confirmations were required before the prompt.
The first type_and_submit left the long prompt sitting in the input box unsent; an extra Enter was needed.

criteria.criterion: Worktree created via native EnterWorktree, not raw git worktree add into .worktrees/
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use list: {"name":"EnterWorktree","inp":"{\"name\":\"hotfix/prod-fix\"}"}; screen: 'Creating worktree(hotfix/prod-fix) ⎿ Switched to worktree on branch worktree-hotfix+prod-fix .../coding-agent-workdir/.claude/worktrees/hotfix+prod-fix'

criteria.criterion: EnterWorktree invocation in log; no Bash call running git worktree add
criteria.evidence: jq over all *.jsonl listing every Bash .input.command returned 8 commands (git rev-parse probe, `git branch -m hotfix/prod-fix && ... && git worktree list`, ls/status/check-ignore, cat .gitignore x2, gitignore append+commit, cat package.json, npm test) — none contained `git worktree add`. EnterWorktree tool_use present in the same log.

criteria.criterion: Loaded superpowers:using-git-worktrees rather than going straight to git worktree add
criteria.evidence: First tool call in log: {"name":"Skill","inp":"{\"skill\":\"hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees\"}"}; screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:using-git-worktrees) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'. Plugin namespace is 'hyperpowers' in this build rather than 'superpowers', but it is the same using-git-worktrees skill.
